# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest stable release. Older versions may not receive security updates.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.

Send a private report to [contact@wooserv.com](mailto:contact@wooserv.com) with:

- A description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce it.
- The affected version or versions.
- Any suggested mitigation.

We will acknowledge valid reports and coordinate disclosure after a fix or mitigation is available.
